---
title: "Diagram alternative text escaping"
format:
  docx: default
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    pdf-standard: ua-1
_quarto:
  tests:
    docx:
      ensureDocxXpath:
        -
          - '//wp:docPr[contains(@descr, "quote") and contains(@descr, "<tag>") and contains(@descr, "café 한글")]'
          - '//wp:docPr[@descr=""]'
          - '//w:t[contains(., "Decorative visible caption")]'
        - []
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'café 한글'
        - []
---

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-alt: >-
%%|   A "quote" & <tag> \ path
%%|   café 한글
flowchart LR
  A[Start] --> B[End]
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="docx"}

```{dot}
//| fig-cap: "Decorative visible caption"
//| fig-alt: ""
digraph G { Start -> End }
```

:::
